versions.changelog: Promote Hive Builder to the formal product version line. Establish it as the complete mother skill and public entry point for Hive, with modern OpenClaw-native runtime positioning and 2026.4.9 calibration wording.

Calibrate Hive Builder for OpenClaw 2026.4.9. Reposition it as the complete product entry point, update modern-runtime wording, and refresh publish-facing language to reflect current OpenClaw-native primitives without requiring a Hive rebuild.

Initial public release aligned with OpenClaw 4.5. Adds safe Hive architecture scaffolding, activation boundaries, runtime selection guidance, ACP-aware specialist runtime notes, and ClawHub-ready publish boundaries.
Position hive-builder as the complete mother skill for users while clarifying that modular hive-* skills are internal implementation/evolution layers.
Clarify builder-vs-CEO layering, document modular Hive subskills, and update README/SKILL to reflect the current runtime/build split.

Expanded README into a bilingual English/Chinese guide. Clarified intended use, non-goals, operating model, recommended usage sequence, mature-workspace guidance, and the safer OpenClaw adoption model for Hive Builder.

Refined published docs and page content for safer OpenClaw use: rewrote README to reflect the architecture/scaffolding role of Hive Builder, tightened the public skill description, and clarified fresh-workspace vs existing-workspace adoption, phased setup, and non-activation by default.

Refactored Hive Builder for safer OpenClaw adoption: added fresh-workspace vs existing-workspace modes; separated assess, plan, scaffold, and activation phases; clarified that installation is not activation; added activation checklist; rewrote README, templates, and expansion example as planning/scaffold materials instead of direct deployment instructions.
Description bilingual (中英双语), 突出'一人公司'定位; 优化 Purpose 章节, 说明 Orchestrator 模式 + sessions_spawn 机制

Initial publish: Orchestrator pattern Hive system with CEO/HRM/OPS architecture, subagent dispatching via sessions_spawn, dual workflow chains, business specialist ROLE.md template, proactivity memory and SETUP.md guidance
